### 3.5 Instruments retired, and why

Named here because a reader needs to know what was tried and dropped, not to
pad an appendix:
proposed: Merge into Appendix A — Null results, consolidating the five-row table with the corresponding null and retired-instrument entries there.
rationale: Failed and retired instruments are audit material, not part of the main methodological sequence. Consolidation also removes repetition between §3.5 and Appendix A while preserving the full record.
